text_block_list.text:
One day, I attended a fan event with Royce 
and Royce. On the way home—
choice_data_list: It was a huge success, huh!
It was a huge success, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, both the flow of the talk and the 
audience's reaction were spot on! Fufu, 
with this, Royce-chan's charm has spread 
even further across the world!

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text: "U-Um, Royce-chan! Do you have a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh, you are...—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who always comes to my 
events! Thank you for cheering for me so 
much today too! I was super happy!"

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, you remembered?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! You're always waving to me 
with both hands, right? It makes me so 
happy, I'd never forget♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, you didn't seem as energetic as 
usual today. ...Did something happen, by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, to think you even noticed 
that... ...To be honest, there's something 
troubling me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, you want to enter Tracen Academy! 
I'd be so happy if you became my junior♪

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even though I love running, I'm 
not fast. Mom and Dad probably thought I 
couldn't make it either... Thinking that, 
I just couldn't bring myself to say it..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Still, don't you want to come?

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No matter how hard it is, I don't 
want to give up. Because I want to be just 
like Royce-chan— always cheerful, giving 
courage to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. In that case, it's simple. Let's 
produce your image so that your feelings 
truly reach your parents!

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text: —...Huh? ...What?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For example—are you good in the morning? 
Maybe you could let your parents see you 
run every morning.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Where do you do your race research? You're 
not shyly hiding it away, are you? You've 
gotta proudly show off how hard you're 
working!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—That's how you think about what you can 
do. Of course, worries will remain, 
wondering if you're lacking something.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'll keep believing and keep 
going! I'll make up for what I lack with 
hard work and get closer to my ideal self!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just an act at first, if you 
become who you want to be, you win!

text_block_list.name: Girl at the Event
text_block_list.text:
Royce... Thank you so much! I'll give it a 
try!

Later on, a fan letter arrived from that 
girl, sharing that she'd received 
permission to take the Tracen Academy 
entrance exam—
choice_data_list: Looks like the strategy paid off.
Looks like the strategy paid off.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Using the self-promotion skills 
Royce-chan taught me directly, conveying 
my passion to their parents will be 
simple!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And then someday, once she becomes a 
strong Umamusume, if she says, 
'Royce-chan's words saved me!' it'll be a 
massive success!"

While giving spot-on advice, she also 
slyly laid groundwork for the future. I 
couldn't help but admire Royce and Royce.
